Dear [Miss Manning](/person/2001),
I am sorry not to have been able sooner to answer you and tell you how much I like your [friend](/person/175)’s [Stone cutter](/organisation/175), whom I shall most gladly have in the [Monthly Packet](/periodical/52), though I am afraid it can hardly be before the end of the year, as though in the enlarged size of the Monthly Packet I can generally get a short self-contained story in every month, I am engaged a good deal in advance with them

Yours sincerely

C M Yonge
